value.title: Phase 1: lock + advice + sweep
value.summary: One coder, tasks in order, every assertion pinned to a backpressure row.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Work top to bottom; stop-and-ask o-prime on anything outside the fence.

value.title: Serialise create/drop in fs3_store with one process-wide tokio Semaphore; N from FS3_DB_MUTATION_CONCURRENCY defaulting to 1, max 2; route duplicate test helpers through the primitives and remove testkit wrappers
value.success: concurrency test green; red with the lock removed
value.receipt: Store-level FS3_DB_MUTATION_CONCURRENCY semaphore guards create_database, drop_database, and drop_database_if_idle; store helper routes through primitives; N=8 create-path test passed (artifact://117) and failed with 8 in flight when permit removed; default-parallel fs3-store suite passed 137 tests in 4m15s (artifact://161) with 0 recovery lines; 83 forced-checkpoint lines and pg_stat_bgwriter +128 are reported, not gated, because each DROP forces one and serialization removes overlap/coalescence

value.title: Truthful advice: classify the connect error (refused vs closed/recovering — SQLSTATE 57P03 or an EOF after connect) and word the panic accordingly; drop the compose suggestion when a server is listening
value.receipt: cargo test -p fs3-testkit advice: 3 passed for refused, bad-password, and accept-then-close cases (artifact://123); auth reports fix credentials with no compose or recovery advice; disabling the auth branch failed the bad-password test while close/recovery cases remained (artifact://125)

value.title: Sweep matches minted names: parse both `fs3_test_<epoch>_<hex>` and `fs3_<label>_<epoch>_<hex>`; keep the age threshold; add a list-only mode that returns candidates without dropping
value.success: sweep test green for both shapes; red without
value.receipt: Shared :5433 sweep tests passed with two idle old names dropped, one live-at-list old name excluded, and one database connected after listing preserved with connection usable (artifact://154); replacing per-drop numbackends recheck plus unforced DROP with FORCE killed the racing database and failed (artifact://152); removing list numbackends predicate also failed (artifact://106)

value.title: Real usage on the dedicated test postmaster: run the oversize suite at default parallelism; inspect flowspace3-db-test logs for recovery lines in that window; record counts
value.receipt: Window start 2026-09-02T00:54:34Z; FS3_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://flowspace3:flowspace3@127.0.0.1:5433/flowspace3_test cargo test -p fs3-daemon --test oversize: 12 passed in 13.81s (artifact://59); docker logs flowspace3-db since start: recovery signature count 0

value.title: Gate and PR: harness checks green; fix: commits via harness commit; PR into main with the mutation stated
value.receipt: harness checks: green 2026-09-02T01:05:54Z; commit 5c7f7bdb069cdb79de3bcf2203d57f934a75c22c verified by refs/notes/ai; PR #95 opened; GitHub gate passed in 5m5s on run 33578074863; lock-removal mutation stated in PR body

value.title: With o-prime: sweep list mode against the prod server (read-only) naming the orphans; after GO, the drop; before/after counts into the receipt

tk-0101.assertion: at most N in flight observed; >1 with the lock removed (mutation in PR)

tk-0102.assertion: recovery wording and no-server wording each asserted; no compose text when listening

tk-0103.assertion: two old minted names swept, one fresh kept, both shapes

tk-0104.assertion: test exit 0 and log grep count 0, with the time window stated

tk-0105.assertion: harness checks green; CI green on the PR head
